anomalies.observed: On the EthernetAndPower sheet, USB connector J6 pin 3 (D+) is on NET0052 and pin 2 (D-) is on NET0005. On the SkylabModule sheet, SKW92A U11 pin 19 (USB-) is on NET0052 and pin 18 (USB+) is on NET0005, so D+ and D- are crossed.
anomalies.expected: USB D+ should connect to the module USB+ pin (U11.18) and USB D- to the module USB- pin (U11.19), preserving D+/D- polarity.
anomalies.impact: The USB data pair is polarity-reversed, so the SKW92A USB interface will not enumerate or communicate correctly; the board may still receive 5 V power from USB.

parsed.summary: The design contains a USB D+/D- polarity swap between the USB connector and the SKW92A module, which would disable USB data communication. No other high-confidence schematic anomaly was identified.
